entities.title: Rally
entities.summary: The game; and, in the engine, the returns made since the last serve (State.rally).

entities.title: Side
entities.summary: 0 for the left paddle, 1 for the right. Against the computer the player is side 0.

entities.title: Seed
entities.summary: A 32-bit number that fixes every random choice in a match. The server issues it for a one-player match that may enter the table.

entities.title: Tick
entities.summary: One fixed step of a match, 1/120 s. Recordings, replays and online lockstep count in ticks.

entities.title: Recording
entities.summary: A one-player match's player controls: the tick count, and one move per change of control.

entities.title: Level
entities.summary: How well the computer plays: easy, normal or hard. It also sets what each point is worth.

entities.title: Lockstep
entities.summary: Online play in which every browser runs the whole match and steps only once it has every player's controls for that step.

entities.title: Delay
entities.summary: How many steps ahead a browser schedules its own player's controls online, chosen at the start from the measured connections.
notToBeConfusedWith: The serve delay, 0.9 s with the ball on the server's paddle.

entities.title: Fingerprint
entities.summary: A hash of the match's numbers that the browsers compare every 120 steps online, to notice if their matches differ.

entities.title: Games hub
entities.summary: The site's games Worker in another repository: the multiplayer lobby, the match relay and /games/me.
